title: TC-TM-UI-05 hangs: createTestTenant triggers onboarding saga that never completes
description: TC-TM-UI-05 used createTestTenant() to create a fixture tenant, which calls the onboarding API and waits for the saga to complete. The onboarding saga (runSagaBackground) never transitions from pending to completed, causing the test to hang at waitForOnboardingTerminalState.
root_cause: The onboarding saga does not complete in the test environment. Tests that need to modify tenant data should use existing tenants from the list page instead of creating fixture tenants via the onboarding API.
error_detail: Test hangs at waitForOnboardingTerminalState — saga stays in pending state indefinitely.
resolution: Rewrote TC-TM-UI-05 to navigate to /admin/tenants, click edit on an existing tenant, modify display_name, save, verify redirect, then restore original name. No longer uses createTestTenant.
prevention: E2E tests that modify tenant data should use existing tenants from the list page. Do not use createTestTenant() as it depends on the onboarding saga which may not complete in the test environment.
